```{r}
save_and_show <- function(file, width, height, plot_fun) {
  pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  plot_fun()
  invisible(dev.off())
  plot_fun()
}

n_per_group_txt <- function(mat) {
  grp <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", unlist(attr(mat, "group")))
  n   <- table(factor(grp, levels = unique(grp)))
  if (length(unique(n)) == 1) {
    paste0("n = ", n[[1]], " per group")
  } else {
    paste(names(n), "n =", n, collapse = ", ")
  }
}
```

## Load targeted LC-MS data

```{r}
list.files(params$data_dir)
dat_files <- c(
  "Model 1 - RMB-1 drugs"          = "Model 1-targeted_EXP 02.387 LC-MS RMB-1 with drugs targeted.csv",
  "Model 2 - HL-60 drugs"          = "Model 2-targeted_EXP 02.385 LC-MS HL-60 with drugs targeted.csv",
  "Model 4 - MLL-PTD FLT3-ITD AZA" = "Model 4-targeted_EXP 02.201 LC-MS Mll-PDT Flt3-ITD BM with aza targeted.csv"
)

load_targeted <- function(file) {
  raw <- read_csv(file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                  name_repair = "minimal") |>
    as.data.frame()
  mat <- apply(raw[-1, -1], 2, as.numeric)
  rownames(mat) <- raw[-1, 1]
  attr(mat, "group") <- raw[1, -1]
  mat
}

dat_target <- lapply(file.path(params$data_dir, dat_files), load_targeted)
names(dat_target) <- names(dat_files)

dat_target <- lapply(dat_target, function(m) {
  rownames(m)[rownames(m) == "Uridine diphosphate-N-acetylglucosamine"] <- "UDP-GlcNAc"
  m
})

model_names <- names(dat_target)
plot_titles <- c("RMB-1", "HL-60", "AML-MLL-PTD FLT3-ITD")

model_desc <- c(
  "RMB-1 cells treated for 24 h with vehicle (VEH), cytarabine (CYT), daunorubicin (DAU) or azacytidine (AZA)",
  "HL-60 cells treated for 24 h with vehicle (VEH), cytarabine (CYT), daunorubicin (DAU) or azacytidine (AZA)",
  "bone marrow of Mll-PTD/Flt3-ITD AML mice treated with vehicle (VEH) or azacytidine (AZA) from day 14 to day 18 and harvested on day 23"
)
```

## Differential tests

```{r}
run_anova_tukey <- function(mat) {
  groups <- as.factor(unlist(attr(mat, "group")))

  res <- apply(mat, 1, function(vals) {
    df <- data.frame(value = as.numeric(vals), group = groups)
    df <- df[!is.na(df$value), ]

    if (length(unique(df$group)) < 2) {
      return(list(F_value = NA, p_value = NA, df_between = NA, df_within = NA,
                  n_sig_vs_VEH = NA, sig_vs_VEH = NA))
    }

    fit <- aov(value ~ group, data = df)
    s   <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    tukey      <- TukeyHSD(fit)$group
    veh_rows   <- tukey[grepl("A_VEH", rownames(tukey)), , drop = FALSE]
    sig_mask   <- veh_rows[, "p adj"] < 0.05 & !is.na(veh_rows[, "p adj"])
    sig_groups <- gsub("^-|-$", "", gsub("A_VEH", "", rownames(veh_rows)[sig_mask]))

    list(
      F_value      = round(s["group", "F value"], 4),
      p_value      = s["group", "Pr(>F)"],
      df_between   = s["group", "Df"],
      df_within    = s["Residuals", "Df"],
      n_sig_vs_VEH = sum(sig_mask),
      sig_vs_VEH   = paste(sig_groups, collapse = ";")
    )
  })

  out <- bind_rows(lapply(res, as.data.frame), .id = "metabolite") |>
    mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) |>
    select(metabolite, df_between, df_within, F_value, p_value, p_adjusted,
           n_sig_vs_VEH, sig_vs_VEH) |>
    arrange(p_adjusted) |>
    mutate(p_value = signif(p_value, 4), p_adjusted = signif(p_adjusted, 4))
  rownames(out) <- out$metabolite
  out
}

run_welch_ttest <- function(mat) {
  groups <- as.factor(unlist(attr(mat, "group")))
  lv     <- levels(groups)

  res <- apply(mat, 1, function(vals) {
    v  <- as.numeric(vals)
    g1 <- v[groups == lv[1] & !is.na(v)]
    g2 <- v[groups == lv[2] & !is.na(v)]

    if (length(g1) < 2 || length(g2) < 2) return(rep(NA_real_, 5))

    tt <- t.test(g1, g2, var.equal = FALSE)
    c(round(mean(g1), 2), round(mean(g2), 2),
      round(unname(tt$statistic), 4), round(unname(tt$parameter), 2), tt$p.value)
  })

  out <- as.data.frame(t(res))
  colnames(out) <- c("mean_A_VEH", "mean_B_AZA", "t_value", "df", "p_value")
  out <- out |>
    mutate(metabolite = rownames(out),
           p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) |>
    select(metabolite, mean_A_VEH, mean_B_AZA, t_value, df, p_value, p_adjusted) |>
    arrange(p_adjusted) |>
    mutate(p_value = signif(p_value, 4), p_adjusted = signif(p_adjusted, 4))
  rownames(out) <- out$metabolite
  out
}

res_diff <- list(
  run_anova_tukey(dat_target[[1]]),
  run_anova_tukey(dat_target[[2]]),
  run_welch_ttest(dat_target[[3]])
)
names(res_diff) <- model_names
```

## Combined table and hit sets

```{r}
fisher_p <- function(p) {
  p <- p[!is.na(p)]
  if (length(p) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  pchisq(-2 * sum(log(p)), df = 2 * length(p), lower.tail = FALSE)
}

combined <- res_diff[[1]] |>
  select(metabolite, p_m1 = p_value, padj_m1 = p_adjusted,
         n_sig_vs_VEH_m1 = n_sig_vs_VEH, sig_vs_VEH_m1 = sig_vs_VEH) |>
  full_join(res_diff[[2]] |>
              select(metabolite, p_m2 = p_value, padj_m2 = p_adjusted,
                     n_sig_vs_VEH_m2 = n_sig_vs_VEH, sig_vs_VEH_m2 = sig_vs_VEH),
            by = "metabolite") |>
  full_join(res_diff[[3]] |>
              select(metabolite, p_m4 = p_value, padj_m4 = p_adjusted),
            by = "metabolite")

combined$p_fisher <- apply(combined[, c("p_m1", "p_m2", "p_m4")], 1, fisher_p)

combined <- combined |>
  mutate(p_fisher_adj = p.adjust(p_fisher, method = "BH"),
         n_sig        = rowSums(cbind(padj_m1, padj_m2, padj_m4) < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(p_fisher_adj)

core_hits <- combined |>
  filter(n_sig == 3, n_sig_vs_VEH_m1 == 3, n_sig_vs_VEH_m2 == 3) |>
  pull(metabolite)

any_hits <- list(
  combined$metabolite[which(combined$n_sig_vs_VEH_m1 == 3)],
  combined$metabolite[which(combined$n_sig_vs_VEH_m2 == 3)],
  combined$metabolite[which(combined$padj_m4 < 0.05)]
)
names(any_hits) <- model_names

alpha <- 0.05
sig_list <- list(
  "RMB-1"            = combined$metabolite[which(combined$padj_m1 < alpha & combined$n_sig_vs_VEH_m1 == 3)],
  "HL-60"            = combined$metabolite[which(combined$padj_m2 < alpha & combined$n_sig_vs_VEH_m2 == 3)],
  "Mll-PTD Flt3-ITD" = combined$metabolite[which(combined$padj_m4 < alpha)]
)

make_group_sets <- function(df, col) {
  df_sub     <- df[!is.na(df[[col]]) & nzchar(trimws(df[[col]])), ]
  all_groups <- sort(unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(df_sub[[col]], ";")))))
  all_groups <- all_groups[nzchar(all_groups)]

  setNames(
    lapply(all_groups, function(g) {
      df_sub$metabolite[
        vapply(strsplit(df_sub[[col]], ";"), function(x) g %in% trimws(x), logical(1))
      ]
    }),
    all_groups
  )
}

venn2_list <- make_group_sets(combined, "sig_vs_VEH_m1")
names(venn2_list) <- gsub("._", "", names(venn2_list))
venn3_list <- make_group_sets(combined, "sig_vs_VEH_m2")
names(venn3_list) <- gsub("._", "", names(venn3_list))
sig_m4 <- sort(combined$metabolite[!is.na(combined$padj_m4) & combined$padj_m4 < 0.05])
```

## UpSet plot - significant hits per model

```{r}
plot_upset_hits <- function(sets_list, keep_order = FALSE,
                            text_scale = c(1.6, 2, 1.43, 2.2, 2.2, 2.2),
                            point_size = 5, line_size = 1.5) {
  full_int <- Reduce(intersect, sets_list)
  qry <- if (length(full_int) > 0) {
    list(list(query = intersects, params = list(names(sets_list)),
              color = "darkorange", active = TRUE))
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  upset(fromList(sets_list),
        nsets           = length(sets_list),
        sets            = names(sets_list),
        keep.order      = keep_order,
        nintersects     = NA,
        mb.ratio        = c(0.75, 0.25),
        order.by        = "freq",
        mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size",
        sets.x.label    = "# Altered Metabolites",
        text.scale      = text_scale,
        point.size      = point_size,
        line.size       = line_size,
        set_size.show   = FALSE,
        main.bar.color  = "black", matrix.color = "black", sets.bar.color = "black",
        queries         = qry)
}
```

make_treat_venn <- function(sets, title) {
  ggVennDiagram(sets, label = "count", label_alpha = 0,
                set_color = "black", edge_lty = "solid") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D6604D") +
    labs(title = title, fill = "Count") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "none")
}

p2 <- make_treat_venn(venn2_list, "RMB-1") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .1))
p3 <- make_treat_venn(venn3_list, "HL-60")

gp2 <- ggplotGrob(p2)
gp3 <- ggplotGrob(p3)

layout_mat <- rbind(
  c(1,  NA,  2),
  c(NA,  4, NA),
  c(NA,  3, NA)
)

tag_sets <- function(sets, model, common) {
  setNames(
    lapply(sets, function(x) ifelse(x %in% common, x, paste0(model, "::", x))),
    paste(model, names(sets))
  )
}

venn_upset_sets <- c(

  tag_sets(venn3_list,          "HL-60",            core_hits),

# Supplementary figures

## Heatmaps - All metabolites {.tabset}

```{r}
make_heatmap_stats <- function(mat_name, dat_list, hits_core, hits_any,
                               plot_title, stat_list) {

  mat_raw  <- dat_list[[mat_name]]
  grp_raw  <- as.character(attr(mat_raw, "group"))
  grp      <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", grp_raw)

  all_hits <- unique(c(hits_core, hits_any[[mat_name]]))
  rows_use <- all_hits[all_hits %in% rownames(mat_raw)]

  mat_sub  <- mat_raw[rows_use, , drop = FALSE]
  mat_z    <- t(scale(t(as.matrix(mat_sub))))

  row_split    <- factor(ifelse(rows_use %in% hits_core, "Core", "Any"),
                         levels = c("Core", "Any"))
  row_fontface <- ifelse(rows_use %in% hits_core, "bold", "plain")

  grp_levels <- unique(grp)
  grp_cols   <- cs$SampleGroup

  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = anno_block(
      gp        = gpar(fill = grp_cols[grp_levels], col = NA),
      labels    = grp_levels,
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "white", fontface = "bold")
    ),
    simple_anno_size     = unit(5, "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend          = FALSE
  )

  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D"))

  stat_df  <- stat_list[[mat_name]]
  stat_sub <- stat_df[match(rows_use, rownames(stat_df)), , drop = FALSE]

  if ("n_sig_vs_VEH" %in% colnames(stat_df)) {
    stat_vals  <- stat_sub$n_sig_vs_VEH
    stat_label <- "N sig.\nvs \nVEH"
  } else {
    stat_vals  <- stat_sub$t_value
    stat_label <- "t value"
  }

  p_adj <- stat_sub$p_adjusted
  sig_labels <- ifelse(is.na(p_adj),       "",
                ifelse(p_adj < 0.0001, "****",
                ifelse(p_adj < 0.001,  "***",
                ifelse(p_adj < 0.01,   "**",
                ifelse(p_adj < 0.05,   "*",
                                       "ns")))))

  stat_range   <- range(stat_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  col_fun_stat <- colorRamp2(
    c(stat_range[1], mean(stat_range), stat_range[2]),
    c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D")
  )

  row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
    stat = anno_simple(
      stat_vals,
      col    = col_fun_stat,
      pch    = sig_labels,
      pt_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold"),
      na_col = "grey90"
    ),
    annotation_name_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    annotation_label       = stat_label,
    show_annotation_name   = TRUE,
    annotation_name_side   = "top",
    annotation_name_rot    = 0,
    annotation_name_offset = unit(2, "mm")
  )

  stat_legend <- Legend(col_fun = col_fun_stat, title = stat_label,
                        direction = "vertical")

  ht <- Heatmap(
    mat_z,
    name                  = "Z-score",
    col                   = col_fun,
    column_title          = plot_title,
    column_title_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    column_title_side     = "top",
    top_annotation        = col_anno,
    right_annotation      = row_anno,
    column_split          = factor(grp, levels = grp_levels),
    cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
    column_gap            = unit(1, "mm"),
    row_split             = row_split,
    row_title             = NULL,
    row_gap               = unit(3, "mm"),
    show_row_names        = TRUE,
    row_names_side        = "left",
    row_names_gp          = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = row_fontface),
    show_row_dend         = FALSE,
    cluster_rows          = TRUE,
    cluster_row_slices    = FALSE,
    cluster_columns       = FALSE,
    show_column_names     = FALSE,
    width  = unit(4 * ncol(mat_z), "mm"),
    height = unit(4 * nrow(mat_z) + 20, "mm")
  )

  list(ht = ht, stat_legend = stat_legend)
}

draw_supp_heatmap <- function(i, file, width, height) {
  res_i    <- res_diff[[i]]
  in_mat   <- rownames(dat_target[[i]])
  sig_i    <- in_mat[in_mat %in% res_i$metabolite[res_i$p_adjusted < 0.05]]
  nonsig_i <- setNames(
    list(in_mat[in_mat %in% res_i$metabolite[res_i$p_adjusted > 0.05]]),
    model_names[i]
  )

  out <- make_heatmap_stats(model_names[i], dat_target, sig_i, nonsig_i,
                            plot_titles[i], stat_list = res_diff)

  save_and_show(file, width, height, function() {
    draw(out$ht,
         heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
         annotation_legend_side = "right",
         merge_legends          = TRUE,
         annotation_legend_list = list(out$stat_legend),
         padding                = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"))
  })
}
```

library(data.table)

dat_files <- list(
  "Model 1 - RMB-1 drugs" = "../data/metabolomics_chemotherapy_creatine/data/raw/Model 1-untargeted_EXP 02.387 LC-MS RMB-1 with drugs untargeted.csv",
  "Model 2 - HL-60 drugs" = "../data/metabolomics_chemotherapy_creatine/data/raw/Model 2-untargeted_EXP 02.385 LC-MS HL-60 with drugs untargeted.csv",
  "Model 3 - RMB-1 AZA" = "../data/metabolomics_chemotherapy_creatine/data/raw/Model 3-untargeted_EXP 02.131 RMB-1 aza-resistant untargeted.csv",
  "Model 4 - MLL-PTD FLT3-ITD AZA" = "../data/metabolomics_chemotherapy_creatine/data/raw/Model 4-untargetedEXP 02.201 LC-MS Mll-PTD Flt3-ITD BM with aza untargeted.csv"
)
dat_imput_type <- list(
  "knn", "knn", "hm", "hm"
)
names(dat_imput_type) <- names(dat_files)

for(DAT_NAM in names(dat_files)){

  ## Loading ----------------------------------------------------------------

  cat("###", DAT_NAM, "\n\n")

  dat_sub <- fread(dat_files[[DAT_NAM]])
  group_sub <- dat_sub[1, ]
  group_sub <- gsub(".*_", "", group_sub[1,])[-1]
  group_sub <- mapvalues(group_sub, c("Cytarabine", "Daunorubicin", "Azacytidine"),
                         c("CYT", "DAU", "AZA"))
  dat_sub <- dat_sub[-1,]

  feat_cols <- colnames(dat_sub)[-1]
  mat <- as.matrix(dat_sub[, ..feat_cols])
  mat <- apply(mat, 2, as.numeric)
  rownames(mat) <- dat_sub[[1]]

  na_only <- which(rowSums(is.na(mat))==ncol(mat))
  if(length(na_only) > 0) mat <- mat[-na_only, ]

  # Imputation ----------------------------------------------------------------

  if(dat_imput_type[[DAT_NAM]] == "knn"){
    set.seed(42)
    imputed <- impute.knn(mat, k = 10, rowmax = 0.5, colmax = 0.8)
    mat_imp  <- imputed$data
  }
  if(dat_imput_type[[DAT_NAM]] == "hm"){
    mat_imp <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
      x[is.na(x)] <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
      x
    }))
  }

  imp_summary <- rbind(
    summarise_mat(mat,     "Before Imputation"),
    summarise_mat(mat_imp, "After Imputation")
  )

  # Transform + PCA ----------------------------------------------------------------
  mat_log    <- log2(mat_imp + 1)
  col_mean   <- colMeans(mat_log)
  col_sd     <- apply(mat_log, 2, sd)
  mat_scaled <- scale(mat_log, center = col_mean, scale = sqrt(col_sd))

  pca_res <- prcomp(t(mat_scaled), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  pca_var <- round(100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:4], 1)

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(pca_res$x),
    PC1    = pca_res$x[, 1],
    PC2    = pca_res$x[, 2],
    PC3    = pca_res$x[, 3]
  )

  grp_vec <- group_sub
  grp_df  <- data.frame(Sample = feat_cols,
                        Group = grp_vec,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  pca_df <- merge(pca_df, grp_df, by = "Sample")

  # Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cs_sub <- cs$SampleGroup[names(cs$SampleGroup) %in% grp_df$Group]

  group_counts <- table(pca_df$Group)
  new_labels   <- paste0(names(group_counts), " (n=", group_counts, ")")
  names(new_labels) <- names(group_counts)

  group_shapes <- c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25)[seq_along(levels(factor(pca_df$Group)))]
  names(group_shapes) <- levels(factor(pca_df$Group))

  p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = Group, fill = Group, shape = Group)) +

    geom_point(size = 7, colour = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
    geom_point(size = 7, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1.2) +

    scale_colour_manual(values = cs_sub, labels = new_labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = cs_sub, labels = new_labels) +
    scale_shape_manual(values  = group_shapes, labels = new_labels) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 3.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = 3.5)) +
    labs(
      x       = paste0("PC1  (", pca_var[1], "% of variance)"),
      y       = paste0("PC2  (", pca_var[2], "% of variance)"),
      colour  = "Group", fill = "Group", shape = "Group"
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 1.2)),
           fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 1.2)),
           shape  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 1.2))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 11),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "grey55", size = 9)
    )
  print(p)

  p_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", DAT_NAM), ".pdf")
  f <- file.path(out_dir_fig, p_name)

  save_and_show(f, width = 3.5, height = 4, function() print(p))

  cat("\n\n")
}
